packageRules.description: Merging a Pocket ID bump publishes a new image tag with that version; the deploy repo then bumps pocket-id and pi-backup together.
prBodyNotes: **Merge this before the Pocket ID bump in homelab-compose.** pi-backup's export only works with the same Pocket ID version as the live database; homelab-compose's CI fails its Pocket ID PR until this image tag exists and Renovate has added the matching pi-backup bump to it.
